stories.headline: Coupa Acquires Tonkean to Expand AI Spend Management

stories.headline: Miner Perpetua Resources secures $2.9 billion U.S. loan for Idaho gold, antimony project
stories.body: Mining company Perpetua Resources has secured a $2.9 billion loan from the U.S. Export-Import Bank as the U.S. looks to secure access to critical minerals.
